Name: Stranded Fish
Author: mikemonroe
Description:
[b][size=3]What it does[/size]

[/b]This mod spawns forageable fish alongside rivers, ponds, and the sea. Both native and modded fish will spawn, modded mainly from the More New Fish mod. The spawned fish species depend on the area and the season, corresponding mostly to the fish that could be caught in that area in that season, but some fish have been excluded from the spawning. Legendaries shouldn't spawn. Please see [b]Locations [/b]section below for supported areas, and [b]Dependencies [/b]section for information on required mods.

[b]Important: the coordinates for the spawns for native maps have been selected with SVE installed, thus they might not make sense unless you have SVE installed too. [/b]I'm unlikely to work out the coordinates for native maps myself, but if someone is willing to provide them I can make a non-SVE version (or they can make and release it). However most areas should be fine currently.

The spawn rates are low, but the fish stay on the ground for 5 days after spawning, and it should give a good amount of fish overall. However the balance hasn't been tested much, the amount could be too much or too little and can be changed.

Supported mods include East Scarpe, Ridgeside Village, Stardew Valley Expanded, and possibly other mods. More details on the [b]Locations [/b]section.


[size=3][b]Locations

[/b][/size]The fish can spawn in

[list]
[*] ﻿The Town
[*] ﻿The Forest
[*] The Secret Woods
[*] The Mountain
[*] ﻿Mines (top floor)
[*] The Beach
[*] ﻿The Sewers
[*] ﻿The Desert
[*] The Forest West (SVE)
[*] East Scarpe (main area)
[*] Ridgeside Village and the Ridge
[*] ﻿Umuwi (Lunna - Astray)
[/list]

[b][size=3]Dependencies[/size]

[/b]The only hard dependency is Farm Type Manager, but More New Fish is strongly recommended, although missing it shouldn't cause problems, except for some log spam from Farm Type Manager. SVE is recommended until the mod has proper coordinates for vanilla maps, but most vanilla maps should be fine.


Please feel free to report problems like illogical spawns and give thoughts on balance.

-Add compatibility with Deluxe Autograbber (can be disabled by deleting the folder that starts with [CP])

-Move mines spawn area to the railroad map
-Add submarine spawns to the beach during the nightmarket
